evals.prompt: Crea una skill pública para revisar contratos de API.
evals.expected_output: A public skill tree with an operational SKILL.md and only runtime resources required by the workflow.
assertions: The skill is classified as public before files are proposed.
The public package excludes metadata.json and evals.
The response explains which optional directories were omitted.

evals.prompt: Crea una skill para las reglas internas de aprobación de lanzamientos.
evals.expected_output: An internal-only skill under .agents/internal-skills with governance metadata and no public vendorization path.
assertions: The skill is classified as internal.
The response does not add it to the public catalog.
The tree can include internal metadata and evals.

evals.prompt: Adapta una skill externa de seguridad para que sea nativa de Skillstack.
evals.expected_output: A native-skill plan that replaces external operating guidance with Skillstack guidance and removes obsolete sources.
assertions: The source is retained only while the skill remains migrating.
The resulting guidance is adapted to Skillstack's operating model.
The plan sets sources to an empty array when the skill becomes native.

evals.prompt: Crea una skill cuyo requisito CRITICAL es no exponer secretos en logs.
evals.expected_output: A skill plan with an explicit critical rule and an observable validation strategy.
assertions: The CRITICAL label expresses impact, not reading order.
The plan proposes a test, linter, or eval that can detect violations.
The rule remains in the SKILL.md business contract.
